morning.caption:
The US Trade Representative proposed new Section 301 tariffs on 14 economies on November 25, with top rates of 35% for Vietnam, 25% for India, 20% for China and 15% for the EU and Japan. Comments are due January 5 and hearings start January 25.

China's commerce ministry said it firmly opposes the plan. General information, not financial advice. More at fiopoin.com

midday.caption:
S&P Global Ratings placed Nvidia's AA credit rating on CreditWatch Negative, citing management and governance concerns after Jensen Huang's return as CEO, AP and Closing Look report. Nvidia shares fell 3.9% to $149.30 on Wednesday after being down more than 9% at one point. General information, not financial advice. More at fiopoin.com

evening.caption:
The Bank of Korea raised its rate to 3.25% on Thursday, its third hike this year, citing inflation and household debt. In the US, October core PCE inflation rose 3.3%, above forecasts, and futures put the odds of a December 9 Fed hike near 98%.

Watch Asia and Europe opens and the Fed on December 9. General information, not financial advice. More at fiopoin.com
